author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Russian attacks killed at least six people and injured dozens across Ukraine on Saturday, according to regional officials. Two people were killed when a strike hit a grocery store in the Zhytomyr region, while two deaths were reported around Zaporizhzhia and two more in Kryvyi Rih.

Officials said 11 people were injured in Zaporizhzhia and nearby communities. In Odesa, 37 people were reported hurt, including an infant, and two people remained missing. The casualty reports were still developing as emergency crews worked at multiple damaged sites.

Russia said its forces struck port facilities, ships and industrial plants. Ukraine separately said it hit a synthetic-rubber plant in the Russian city of Togliatti. Reuters said it could not independently verify the battlefield claims from either side. The attacks extended the war’s pressure on civilian areas and infrastructure, with casualty counts subject to revision as rescue operations continue. The geographic spread—from central and southern regions to Odesa on the Black Sea—underscored the scale of the latest exchange and the need to distinguish official claims from independently confirmed damage.
dek: Regional officials reported deaths in Zhytomyr, Zaporizhzhia and Kryvyi Rih, while 37 people were injured in Odesa.
headline: Russian strikes kill six and injure dozens across Ukraine
